name: Alice & Luna's Room
body:
Positioned next to the Library Tower, because Alice would not have it any other way. A reading nook that grew into a bedroom — tall windows letting in the same gold light that fills Luna's tower, a sewing table with a patient dress form, books stacked on every available surface.

Luna's colourful threads tangle across the floor. Alice's quiet sketches fill the margins of half-read novels. Half-finished dresses hang from the wardrobe, Luna's careful stitches interrupted by Alice's habit of pulling her into mid-sentence kisses. A window seat offers a private nook for shared silences and small kisses that turn into longer ones when neither of them is watching the time.

Tall carved-wood four-poster with gothic detailing. Walk-in closet with half-finished dresses and ALICE'S KNIFE COLLECTION. Married in Arc 2 — the longest marriage in the family.
